name: Waypoint Queue (Tetz fork)
author: PrinceOfPluto, Tetz95
description: Expands AE waypoint mode to support multiple waypoints, complex switching orders, brake management, refueling, and more. Tetz95's fork of PrinceOfPluto's Waypoint Queue: keeps the train's pose through the queue and shows the train as it will be at each waypoint, with fixes for switches, coupling, cutting and refueling.
